issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

id.description:
The identifier of this config.

It should match the name the package that this accessToken is giving access to.

ownerEmail.description: The email of the token owner

title:
This configuration provides access tokens for particular UI packages.

Users of those packages can define their token in a running server or seed it in the config folder.

If you need a token and don't know how or where to get one, reach out to your dependency's author.

Component Developers: If you need to protect a package through this configuration, you'll have to provide metadata in {@link UiSdlModuleProtection} and
provide documentation for your customers on how to acquire a token.
name: UiSdlComponentPackageAccess
